title: The Last Letter: Tube Failing
statement: Lumen put the plate on a light box and the whole thing went calm and pale. Light boxes have tubes, and tubes fail. One has gone: a diagonal half of the box is dark now, and in that half the film reads the way it did before Lumen touched it, dark ground, pale bones, green disc, the radiograph coming back as the light goes. Along the edge where the live tube meets the dead one there is a line of hot pink, the colour a tube makes in its last hour. Half the spine is a shadow on light and half is a light in shadow, and the green piece sits exactly on the border, half each. Nothing has been read in either half. The next hand can replace the tube.
process: I kept Lumen's light-box plate exactly, the pale field, the grey shadow fragments, the dark green piece and the edge marks, and overlaid a diagonal half of the plate with a near-black fill holding the radiograph version of the same fragments and the green disc in full colour, with a bright pink line along the diagonal where the two halves meet.
